info.title: Wandora API
info.description: REST API for Wandora stays: authentication, user profiles, friendships, hotels and rooms, hosts and applications, bookings, payments, booking drives and collaborative travel planning. Authenticated routes expect the HttpOnly ACCESS_TOKEN session cookie issued by POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/register; use the Authorize button to supply its value. Every error response uses the project's ApiError envelope (success, message, error, dateTime, info).

tags.name: Host Profile
tags.description: Host profile creation and maintenance, plus host phone/email OTP verification. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: Rooms
tags.description: Room creation, lookup and deactivation for a hotel. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: Booking Drive
tags.description: Trip photo storage attached to a booking. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: User Discovery
tags.description: Browse other users of the platform. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: Friendships
tags.description: Friend requests and friendship lookups between existing users. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Booking creation, guests, payment initiation and cancellation. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Account registration, sign-in, session refresh, OTP verification and logout. Sessions are issued as HttpOnly cookies (ACCESS_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN), not as bearer tokens.

tags.name: Host Applications
tags.description: Host onboarding applications and their identity documents. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: My Profile
tags.description: Read and update the authenticated user's own profile. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: Hotel Search
tags.description: Public hotel and room discovery. The search route and its public photo/info helpers are listed as permitAll routes in the security configuration.

tags.name: Hotels
tags.description: Hotel creation, maintenance, photos, hotel applications and hotel bookings for hosts. All routes require an authenticated session.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administrator-only operations. Every route requires the persisted ADMIN role (exposed to Spring Security as ROLE_ADMIN); non-admin sessions receive 403.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Razorpay payment verification and payment webhooks.

UserProfileResponseDto.description: The caller's own profile. Password hashes, refresh tokens, provider ids and verification secrets are never included.

emailVerified.description: Whether the email address has been verified

PhoneNumberDto.description: Phone number for which an OTP will be sent during host verification.

EmailDataDto.description: Email address for which an OTP will be sent during host verification.

HostDataCreateDto.description: Create the host profile after a host application has been approved. Business name is copied from the approved application, not sent here.

description.description: Optional description of the host business

active.description: Whether the host profile starts active

HostDataDto.description: Host profile data: business identity, office contact points, verification status and rating.

officePhoneNumbers.description: Office phone numbers (10-digit Indian mobile format)

businessName.description: Business name taken from the approved host application

CreatePlanRequest.description: Create a travel plan. title and destination are required (max 160 chars), description max 2000, startDate must not be after endDate, budget must be >= 0 and currency must be a 3-letter ISO code.

PlanResponse.description: Travel plan as returned by the API. createdBy is the owning user id and createdByName is their display name; timestamps are ISO date-times.

StayOptionRequest.description: Propose a stay by referencing an existing hotel id. estimatedPrice is a planning estimate only (>= 0) and never affects hotel pricing or availability; selected marks the chosen option.

StayOptionResponse.description: Stay option with denormalised hotel name and city for display; the hotel itself is only referenced by id.

MessageRequest.description: Chat message body, 1 to 4000 characters. The sender is always taken from the authenticated principal.

MessageResponse.description: Stored chat message. messageType is TEXT or SYSTEM and createdAt is the server-side creation timestamp.

ItineraryRequest.description: Create an itinerary item. activityDate must fall within the plan dates, latitude is -90..90, longitude -180..180, and endTime must not precede startTime when both are supplied.

ItineraryResponse.description: Itinerary item as stored, including its parent plan and creator.

InvitationRequest.description: Invite an existing friend by their user id. The target must be a friend of the plan owner.

MemberResponse.description: Plan membership with role (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER) and status (INVITED, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, REMOVED) plus who invited the member and when they joined.

InvitationResponseRequest.description: Respond to the caller's own invitation with ACCEPTED or DECLINED. Any other membership status is rejected.

BookingLinkRequest.description: Link an existing booking to the plan by id. The booking must belong to the caller; nothing is booked or paid.

BookingLinkResponse.description: Association between a plan and an existing booking, with denormalised hotel and stay details for display.

basePrice.description: Base price per night (> 0, max 8 integer and 2 decimal digits)

totalCount.description: Inventory of this room type, 1 to 10000

RoomCreatedResponseDto.description: Room as returned immediately after creation.

PaymentVerificationDto.description: Values returned by the Razorpay checkout that are sent back to the server for signature verification. No payment credential or secret is included.

razorpayOrderId.description: Razorpay order id returned when the payment was initiated

razorpaySignature.description: HMAC signature produced by Razorpay for this payment

BookingInfoDto.description: Booking as returned by the API. Validation annotations on the fields document the checks applied when the same shape is accepted as input.

bookingStatus.description: Current status: RESERVED, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, FAILED or EXPIRED

guests.description: Users attached to the booking as guests

GuestDto.description: Summary of a user attached to a booking as a guest. No contact details are exposed.

HotelCreationReqDto.description: Create the hotel after a hotel application has been APPROVED. Name, city and contact details are copied from that application, so only amenities and the initial active flag are sent here.

amenities.description: Initial amenities; an empty set is allowed

HotelDataDto.description: Host-facing hotel record with contact details, photos, amenities and the active flag.

hotelName.description: Hotel name, copied from the approved application

city.description: City, copied from the approved application

ContactInfoDTO.description: Property contact block submitted with a hotel application. Required fields are state, building, street, an Indian PIN code, phone and email.

HotelApplicationRequestDto.description: JSON application part (hotel name, city, contact details, description)

policyType.description: Policy type from the RefundPolicyType enum

RefundRuleReq.description: One tier of a refund policy: how many hours before check-in the rule applies and the percentage refunded.

hoursBeforeCheckIn.description: Hours before check-in the rule applies from

HotelApplicationResponse.description: Hotel application as returned to its owning host: review status, hotel details, optional rejection reason and review timestamp. Verification file contents are exposed through the separate documents endpoint.

HostApplicationResponse.description: Host application as returned to its owner: review status, business name, optional rejection reason, review timestamp and the document type names. Document bytes are fetched from the separate photos endpoint.

FriendshipResponseDto.description: A friendship involving the current user.

status.description: Friendship state from the FriendShipStatus enum

BookingPhotoDto.description: Photo stored in a booking drive, with a time-limited signed download URL.

OrderInfoDto.description: Payment order details returned when a booking payment is initiated. key is the Razorpay key id used by the client to open the checkout; amount is in the currency's smallest unit (paise for INR).

key.description: Razorpay key id used by the payment client

amount.description: Order amount in the smallest currency unit

BookingRequestDto.description: Request to initialize a booking: which room, how many of them and the stay dates. Creates a RESERVED booking only; payment happens on a separate call.

roomsCount.description: Number of rooms to reserve, at least 1

checkInDate.description: Check-in date (ISO-8601 date, today or later)

checkOutDate.description: Check-out date (ISO-8601 date, today or later, after check-in)

OtpVerificationReq.description: One-time password submitted for account verification.

email.description: Email address the OTP was sent to

RegisterRequest.description: New account details. Username and email must be unique; the password is stored BCrypt-hashed and is never returned by the API.

password.description: Plain password, 8 to 72 characters; never echoed back

gender.description: Optional gender: FEMALE, MALE, OTHER (as defined by the Gender enum)

AuthResponse.description: Public account payload returned by register, login and refresh. Session tokens are NOT part of the body; they are set as HttpOnly cookies (ACCESS_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN).

roles.description: Persisted role names, for example USER, HOST, ADMIN

LoginRequest.description: Credentials for sign-in. identifier is either the username or the email address.

HostUpdateDto.description: Editable host profile fields. The service applies hostName and description only when they are present, and always applies the active flag.

active.description: Whether the host profile is active

PhoneVerifyDto.description: Confirm the OTP sent for host phone verification.

EmailDataVerifyDto.description: Confirm the OTP sent for host email verification.

UpdatePlanRequest.description: Partial plan update: only the supplied fields are changed. Omitted fields keep their current values. The service rejects date changes that would push existing itinerary items outside the plan window.

StayOptionUpdateRequest.description: Partial stay-option update: notes, estimated price (>= 0) and selected flag.

StatusRequest.description: Requested plan status: PLANNING, READY_TO_BOOK, BOOKED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED. BOOKED requires at least one linked booking.

UpdateItineraryRequest.description: Partial itinerary update: omitted fields are left unchanged; the same date, time and coordinate validations apply to supplied values.

ReorderRequest.description: New itinerary ordering as a list of item ids. Every id must belong to the same plan.

RoomDto.description: Room details including stored photo URLs, amenities, inventory, capacity and audit timestamps.

UpdateProfileRequestDto.description: Editable parts of the caller's profile. Username, email and phone numbers are managed by separate endpoints.

gender.description: Gender value from the Gender enum

HotelUpdateDto.description: Hotel fields the owning host may change: amenities and the active flag. The hotel id is sent as a query parameter on the update route.

RejectionRequest.description: Rejection decision body. The reason is required, trimmed and limited to 1000 characters.

HotelApplicationDetails.description: Hotel application under review with host information, hotel details, rejection reason, review audit data and document metadata.

HotelContact.description: Contact block copied from the embedded ContactInfo value object. Longitude and latitude are decimal strings as stored on the entity.

VerificationDocumentSummary.description: Verification document metadata only. The private storage key and any signed URL are deliberately excluded; use the documents endpoint to obtain a temporary download link.

HostApplicationDetails.description: Host application under review with its applicant, stored rejection reason, review audit data and document metadata.

UserSummaryDto.description: Public user summary used for discovery. Deliberately excludes email, phone numbers, roles and credentials.

InvitationResponse.description: An invitation received by the current user, summarising the plan it belongs to.

HotelRequestInfo.description: Availability search criteria supplied as query parameters to GET /api/hotels/search. The route is public.

roomCount.description: Number of rooms needed, at least 1

HostPubDataDto.description: Public host summary embedded in search results. Verification documents and private identifiers are never included.

HotelPubDataDto.description: Publicly visible hotel data used by the search and hotel-info endpoints: name, city, contact block, photos, amenities, active flag and host summary.

HotelSearchInfoDto.description: Search result row: the publicly visible hotel data plus a price indicator for the requested stay.

price.description: Price used for comparison in the search result

HotelInfoDto.description: Public hotel detail used by search: hotel data with its rooms.

rooms.description: Publicly visible rooms of the hotel

RoomPubDto.description: Publicly visible room data returned by the hotel-info endpoint: type, price, amenities, inventory and capacity.

BookingHotelDto.description: Booking as seen by the hotel owner: hotel, room, stay dates, status and amount.

FriendshipStatusResponseDto.description: Relationship between the current user and another user.

isFriend.description: True when an accepted friendship exists

requestPending.description: True when a friend request is still awaiting a response

BookingDriveDto.description: Photo drive attached to a booking; photos are managed through the /drives/{driveId}/photos endpoints.

HotelSummary.description: Hotel row for admin listings: identity, location, active flag, owning host with its status, and the hotel application status.

HotelDetails.description: Admin detail view of one hotel, including its contact information, host status and hotel-application status. No credentials or storage keys are present.

VerificationDocumentAccess.description: Document metadata plus a time-limited signed download URL generated by the existing private-storage mechanism.

DashboardSummary.description: Database-derived dashboard counters. totalBookings counts persisted bookings excluding FAILED and EXPIRED; the separate status counters sum to that total. Application counters cover both host and hotel applications across all statuses.

cookieAuth.description: Session cookie ACCESS_TOKEN issued by the auth endpoints and read by the JWT filter. It is HttpOnly, so copy its current value from the browser's cookie storage into this field to authorise requests in Swagger UI.
cookieAuth.name: ACCESS_TOKEN
